text.p: These are the leading stories in the Skopje press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified them and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Macedonia starts reconstruction of the road from Novo Selo to Zlatarevo border crossing with Bulgaria, a strech of the East-West road route.
- Greek-Macedonian negotiations over the name are in a final phase. Greeek side insists on the resolution of the problem. Negotiations to continue in Geneva.

- One hundred and twenty Ethnic Albanian pupils from Tetovo were poisoned. This is the fourth case of "clearly political posioning of children in ethnic Albanian areas in Western Macedonia on the eve of local elections designed to prove incompetence by local authorities," the paper says.
- EU welcomes the Yugoslav-Macedonian agreement on exemption of customs duties.
- Macedonian Defence Minister Blagoje Handziski is "silent" about the meeting with his Yugoslav counterpart Pavle Bulatovic. Will Macedonia really buy arms from Serbia?
- PDP party criticises Macedonian police for not revealing the names of "criminals that are poisoning Albanian children in the Tetovo area"
